note: Golden cases for spec.json. Every consumer (TypeScript and Python) must pass all of them.

cases.name: intents R: every read intent
intents S: every search intent, search-first
intents W: every write intent
intents T: every test intent, one T-run is not a loop
intents M: every mcp intent, tool-storm
intents X: every other intent
step kinds: all eight tma-trajectory/2 values
fallback (intent other): family mcp wins over the tool name; Agent, Read, Grep, Edit, Bash
fallback (intent unlabeled): Glob, Write, NotebookEdit, Task, Workflow, ListAgents, no tool
fallback: tool names are case-sensitive (read, grep -> X)
tool-storm boundary: M at positions 3-5 is a storm
tool-storm boundary: M at positions 4-6 is not a storm
tool-storm boundary: two M in the window is not a storm
rule order: tool-storm before search-first
rule order: test-loop before tool-storm
rule order: test-loop before search-first
test-loop: two T-runs separated by W
test-loop boundary: two T-runs separated only by R are not a loop
test-loop: one gap with W is enough (T R T W T)
test-loop: W with other letters in the gap still counts
test-loop boundary: W after the last T-run does not count
empty input: shape other
truncation: exactly 400 steps is not truncated
truncation: 401 steps keeps 400 letters
truncation: the shape reads the truncated string (T W T past 400 is lost)
first failure at step 0: last_good_kind START
first failure mid-run; a later failure is ignored
first failure past the truncation still counts
first failure on a fallback step
mixed sources in one trajectory

path_map_cases.name: repeat collapse: RRRSS is the path R -> RS
min runs: 4 runs is below 5 even at 40 % share
share boundary: 5 of 166 runs (3.01 %) is kept
share boundary: 5 of 167 runs (2.99 %) is dropped
empty kind strings count in the total
branching: prefixes count each run once
